phase_coverage.detail: 145 phases resolve to modules with run()

intentional_behavior_changes: Linux offline denies all network sockets, including local model services; unavailable isolation fails closed.
Access-control confirmation rejects non-success object responses, leaking/invalid controls, and invalid private-object controls.
Delivery sanitizes supported text/SQLite backup cells and rejects unsafe signed/oversized/non-UTF8 text artifacts.

api_runtime_corpus.scope: Eight synthetic loopback HTTP cases: four paired owned-account BOLA positives and four secure/wrong-object negatives. Two repetitions of four scenarios; no held-out projects, mobile coverage, field precision, or payout claim.

prior_proof_corpus.scope: 12 generated local authenticated-capture cases (6 positive, 6 benign) for three existing strict proof classes. Does not measure real-world detector recall or false-positive rates.

proof_control_comparison.scope: Five constructed authenticated capture bundles per version, not a detector benchmark or live HTTP evaluation.

tested: approved offline Python and Go adapters

scope: Local synthetic fixtures and loopback services only; no third-party targets, model quality/throughput, real bounty acceptance, device/emulator/chain runtime or full standards validation.
